verse.verse_1: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_2: All the praises and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
verse.verse_3: The Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_4: The Only Owner (and the Only Ruling Judge) of the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)
verse.verse_5: You (Alone) we worship, and you (Alone) we ask for help (for each and everything).
verse.verse_6: Guide us to the Straight Way
verse.verse_7: The Way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace, not (the way) of those who earned Your Anger, nor of those who went astray.
